response.sql:
WITH filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    l::NUMERIC / g::NUMERIC AS loss_rate
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE g > 53
),
team_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(loss_rate) AS avg_loss_rate
  FROM filtered_rows
  GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_loss_rate)
FROM team_averages;

assumptions.assumption: "pass the 53-game mark" means g > 53 (strictly greater), not g >= 53

alternatives.interpretation: "pass the 53-game mark" could mean g >= 53 (at or above 53)
